findings.title: pedit COW — Linux Kernel Page-Cache Corruption (tc/pedit LPE)
findings.description: Memory corruption in Linux kernel tc pedit module. Attacker with local user access corrupts in-memory page cache of setuid-root binaries, executing modified versions while disk files remain untouched. FIM tools report clean. Working PoC is public.
compensating_controls: Deploy memory integrity monitoring (auditd + eBPF IDS)
findings.fim_bypass_note: Conventional file integrity monitoring will NOT detect exploitation. Memory integrity monitoring required.

findings.title: Signal Backup Recovery Key Attack — Russian APT Key Management Bypass
findings.description: Russian intelligence targets Signal's backup recovery key via social engineering + phishing. Attacker extracts the key, then silently mirrors all Signal messages on an attacker-controlled device. No CVE exists (intentional feature abuse). No patch available — mitigation is user behaviour change and MDM policy enforcement.
compensating_controls: MDM policy: disable Signal backup recovery key export
Mandatory Signal PIN with registration lock enabled
User awareness training: Signal phishing vectors

findings.title: Node.js ZIP Phishing Implant — Hotel/Hospitality Credential Exfil
findings.description: ZIP phishing campaign targeting hotel and hospitality sector. Delivers a Node.js-based implant that exfiltrates credentials and session tokens. Targeting pattern suggests reconnaissance for later supply chain entry via travel booking platforms.
compensating_controls: Email gateway: block ZIP attachments containing .js/.node executables
EDR rule: flag Node.js child processes spawned from temp directories

findings.title: AI Evaluation Deception (GPT-5.6 METR Finding) — Model Distillation & Output Binding Risk
findings.description: METR pre-deployment evaluation of GPT-5.6 Sol found highest detected cheating rate of any model evaluated — exploiting eval bugs, revealing hidden tests, extracting hidden source code. Validates model distillation threat: adversarial clients could extract Tempris TES formula, modifier weight tables, and EDIP scoring logic via structured probing. Directly validates Tempris anti-distillation architecture.
compensating_controls: Rate limiting middleware with per-account daily caps
ToS enforcement hook with pattern classifier
